authority: Stone's February 2 memo, section 1 (stone_to_caldwell_2014_offseason_decisions.md): sign Bray, Murphy, Blake, Long, D'Anthony Smith and Jerrell Jackson to reserve/future contracts at the 2014 minimum for each player's credited seasons, no guarantee, no signing bonus; let King and Ta'ufo'ou go. User instruction of September 29, 2026 to run the reserve/future contracts before advancing to February 17. Caldwell executes: six minimum camp contracts are within the memo he received and cost nothing that counts before the league year; the branch records his agreement as a stated reading, not a draw.
rules: Reserve/future eligibility: players who did not finish 2013 on an active roster (research of September 29, 2026: Profootballrumors February 2014 explainer, confirmed by a second source). Contracts take effect at the 2014 league year (March 11, 4 p.m. ET) and count toward the 90-man limit from then. Jacksonville's 2013 practice-squad contracts have ended, so each player is free to sign anywhere until he signs.
offers: Caldwell makes all six offers on February 3, 2014, the first day after the memo.
rails: League rails method section 3: a player Jacksonville does not sign follows his real next move only if it is a dated move of the same kind in the same window. Checked for each: Bray (on Kansas City's active roster in real 2013; no move in the window), Murphy (none found), Blake (on Pittsburgh's roster; none), Long (none found), Jerrell Jackson (a real 2014 Kansas City contract exists but its date and form are unverified; an undated move cannot enter the branch, section 2), D'Anthony Smith (real Seattle reserve/future contract, February 5, 2014, confirmed by HeraldNet and Field Gulls, February 6, 2014).
uncontested: Bray, Murphy, Blake, Long and Jackson have no dated competing move; each accepts his own club's futures offer on February 3. The branch treats acceptance as certain: an unattached practice-squad player's alternative is no contract.
market_draw: D'Anthony Smith: section 4 market draw at his real signing date, February 5. Jacksonville's February 3 offer is the minimum for his credited seasons with no guarantee. His real Seattle terms are taken to be the same minimum with no guarantee: an inference (a reserve/future contract is ordinarily a minimum deal; the real terms were not read). Both minimums are for the same credited seasons, so the average-per-year ratio is 1 whatever the exact figure; with no real guarantee m uses that ratio alone: m = 1.0, chance 0.50. Jacksonville signs him if the draw is below 0.50; otherwise he signs with Seattle on February 5 and is not Jacksonville's.
salaries: 2014 minimum base salary by credited seasons: 0, $420,000 (confirmed); 1, $495,000 (confirmed); 2, $570,000 (unverified, from the $75,000 step); 3 or more, not read. Each player's credited seasons come from branch history and are left unresolved where not established; the salary field is then 'minimum for credited seasons, figure unresolved'.
draws: One private packet (method, script and snapshot digests); one seeded generator; one draw: Smith.
label_swap: Only the two contracts and the dates are inputs.
outputs: futures_results.json; transaction and state records at closure.
